summary: Mira this is a good first attempt. There is some overlap in your criterion. For example if you look at writing quality you talk about content but you have an entire criterion for content. In a way the rubric is about writing quality. In rubrics we call this the ontological net cast by each thing we are measuring. You do not want things to overlap. #edu407
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Mira this is a good first attempt. There is some overlap in your criterion. For example if you look at writing quality you talk about content but you have an entire criterion for content.

In a way the rubric is about writing quality. In rubrics we call this the ontological net cast by each thing we are measuring. You do not want things to overlap. #edu407
